text: Yes, this asset experienced deforestation. In 2021, tree-cover loss totaling **81.3 hectares** (2.23% of the asset) was observed, primarily in planted forests (*Pinus elliottii y Pinus taeda*). The event was corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data, which confirmed 98% of the area was forested at baseline. While 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in small patches (<0.5 ha) and were excluded from the event count, the remaining area still qualifies as significant deforestation under the analysis parameters. No native forest loss was detected.
